conventions.geometry: (Re x, Im x, asinh(Re(exp(-0.55i) y))). Display rays are truncated; integrals include infinity.
conventions.normalization: Vectors use (1, Re(x), |x|^2); double the middle entry in genus-two determinants.

experiment.L_analytic_assumptions: The supplied Euler factors, conductor and gamma factors are correct; the completed L-function is holomorphic, has the growth required by the generic L-function algorithm, and satisfies its functional equation. Ball arithmetic certifies numerical errors conditional on these hypotheses.
